label: First report
name: Support chat — QL-40 jams with E-41

turns.speaker: lena
turns.text: Our Quillstone QL-40 label printer in the lab keeps jamming with error E-41. Serial QS-40-88217.

turns.speaker: quill
turns.text: Sorry about that. A firmware update usually clears E-41; if it comes back I can ship a replacement under warranty. Where should hardware go?

turns.speaker: lena
turns.text: Ship any hardware to our Lyon office: Brightmoor Labs, 22 Quai Perrache, 69002 Lyon. We are on the Team plan, billed annually.

turns.speaker: quill
turns.text: Noted: hardware goes to 22 Quai Perrache, 69002 Lyon; Team plan, annual billing. The firmware update is on its way.
